title: Kata Persona Forge
tagline: A character, from the inside out.
description: A local-first character workshop with an original layered Blender hair-card crop, regional skin color, pores and roughness, distinct adult faces, adjustable expressions, blink and gaze, an optional rigged A-line skirt and editable GLB export.
features: Original layered Blender hair-card crop with refined temple edges and swept crown
Editable packed Blender groom, 435 guide curves and a manual card-rebake workflow
Portable textured mesh cards preserve the rig and 28 identity morph targets
Original 2048px regional skin color, pore-normal and roughness maps
Restrained browser-only thin-tissue backlight, strongest at the ears
Portable PBR skin textures with verified Blender reimport
Adjustable closed-mouth smile, frown and brow expressions with neutral reset
Coherent cheek movement and gentle smile squint alongside independent blink and gaze
Four original editable expression targets on the human and fitted brows
Independent anatomical left/right blink controls with neutral reset
Bounded horizontal/vertical gaze with fitted lids, lashes, iris and cornea
Ten original editable eye targets and blink/gaze interaction correctives
Three distinct adult face presets plus the preserved original three
Nine additional fitted face controls, from head proportions to lips
CC0 MakeHuman anatomical adult with original portrait detail maps
Neutral studio lighting, iris tint and reflective cornea
Fitted brows and lashes with facial morphs
Textured swept short crop and bald option
53-bone weighted skeleton and four static bone-driven poses
Optional original A-line skirt with nine garment-only auxiliary bones
Hem-sway control, body-build fit morphs and editable garment export
Twenty-eight editable appearance morph targets plus pose correctives
Height scaling and preserved garment/pose fixes
Locally bundled Three.js and labeled software preview
Editable textured rigged GLB export
Body and close face inspection with profile framing
Forty-edit undo and redo
PNG preview and editable project downloads
Backward-compatible loading of existing projects
Best-effort local browser autosave
limitations: Static layered hair cards, not photorealistic or a production groom; some crown arcs and rear layering remain
No mouth interior, jaw controls, lip-sync, automatic blink timing or cloth simulation; closed-mouth expression posing
Skirt fit is checked across supported static poses; arbitrary bone edits may clip
Eyelids can look heavy or stretched at extreme identity combinations
Exported eye targets fit the saved identity; changing identity in Blender may require refitting
Strong expressions are stylized, not a production muscle or wrinkle system
Blender expression edits do not automatically update smile squint or opposing-key cancellation
Procedural refinement of one licensed skin source, not a fully photorealistic scan
Browser skin backlight does not transfer to GLB; Blender receives PBR textures without subsurface scattering
